**Scope**:
- IN: per-stack tool install pinned to mutation.<stack>.tool_version with mutation.<stack>.fallback_versions chain; per-stack runtime cap via mutation.<stack>.timeout_seconds (Stryker 600, mutmut 900, mutant 1200, gremlins 900); partial-result emission with runtime_exceeded=true on timeout; matrix fail-fast false; ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT prominent warning with no bug ticket and aggregate_kill_rate=null when every stack times out; aggregate job merges all stack findings into one PR comment; dso-config.conf default keys for the new stacks.
- OUT: calibration auto-surfacing; threshold enforcement; onboarding/setup integration.","priority":1,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["When this story is complete, the workflow runs Ruby (mutant), JS/TS (Stryker --incremental), and Go (go-gremlins) as parallel matrix jobs with fail-fast false, each installing its tool at mutation.<stack>.tool_version with a mutation.<stack>.fallback_versions chain ← Satisfies: sc-3","When this story is complete, a stack that exceeds mutation.<stack>.timeout_seconds emits a partial findings result with runtime_exceeded=true rather than failing the job ← Satisfies: sc-3","When this story is complete, when every stack returns runtime_exceeded=true the PR comment surfaces an ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT warning, aggregate_kill_rate is null, and no bug ticket is created ← Satisfies: sc-3","When this story is complete, the aggregate job merges all stack findings into a single PR comment using the MUTATION_TESTING_FINDINGS_<pr-number> marker ← Satisfies: sc-3","When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (per-stack timeout partial-result emission, ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT aggregation, multi-stack merge) ← Satisfies: sc-3"],"considerations":["[Cost] Three additional matrix jobs multiply per-PR CI minutes; per-stack timeout caps and the concurrency group from draft-1 bound the worst case.","[Correctness] Monorepo incremental-mode diff scoping is a documented limitation (mutmut on shared packages); do not attempt to mitigate within this story."],"scopeSplitCandidate":true,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["e432-95f0-dd82-4743"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-3"},{"id":"e647-c68a-f921-438a","title":"As a developer scaffolding a new DSO project, I want create-dso-app.sh to set up mutation testing for detected stacks, so that new projects ship with mutation-testing wiring by default.","description":"## Description
